definition: per triggered training step, the fp32 stop decision (gap_final <= tolerance) is re-made in fp64 on the same input; fp32_converged_fp64_not = fp32 reported converged but fp64 does not (judged met when not); fp32_not_fp64_converged = the reverse. Distance = (fp32 gap_final - tolerance) / tolerance. The fp64 gap values themselves are not stored per step (only the agreement flag), so they cannot be tabulated.
denominator_note: the fraction is over diagnostic-triggered steps only, not over all training steps
